references.text: The Lord warns Pharaoh that his firstborn son will die if he does not let Israel go, which foreshadows this plague.
The Lord declares that He will strike down all the firstborn in Egypt, both humans and animals.
Fulfillment of this prophecy: The Lord struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, from Pharaoh's firstborn to the firstborn of the captive.
Moses explains that the Lord struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, which is the basis for the consecration of the firstborn.
Reference to the Lord striking down all the firstborn in Egypt as the reason why the Levites belong to the Lord.
The Lord set apart all the firstborn in Israel on the day He struck down all the firstborn in Egypt.
The psalm describes how God struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, in the tents of Ham.
The psalm reminds us that the Lord struck down all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their strength.
Praise to the Lord who struck down Egypt's firstborn, both humans and livestock.
Thanks to the Lord who struck down Egypt through their firstborn.
The book of Hebrews mentions Passover and the application of blood that protected against the one who destroyed the firstborn.
Highlights the theological dimension of the event: judgment on the gods of Egypt as a result of the death decree.
